slides.title: Main Deck vs Material Deck
slides.subtitle: In Grand Archive you play with two decks. Here's what goes where.

slides.title: The cards you draw
bullets: Up to 4 copies of a card with the same name
It stays face down and shuffled: you can't look at it or reorder it during the game
You only draw cards from your main deck

slides.title: Your champions and regalia
bullets: Up to 12 cards, only 1 copy of each
It must contain at least one Level 0 champion
Champion cards start the game here
You can look at it any time

slides.title: How you use the Material Deck

steps.title: Start of the game
steps.text: Reveal your Level 0 champion and put it onto the field. It isn't materialized and can't be responded to.

steps.title: Materialize Phase
steps.text: Once per turn you may materialize a champion or regalia from your material deck, paying its memory cost. You skip this phase on your first turn.

steps.title: Level up
steps.text: A champion one level higher (N+1) goes on top of your champion, into its lineage.

slides.title: Deck building in short
bullets: Main deck: 60+ cards, max 4 copies per name
Material deck: max 12 cards, all different, with at least one Lv 0 champion
Sideboard: max 15 cards and 15 points (main deck cards = 1, champions and regalia = 3)
A champion card that would go to the graveyard is banished instead
slides.note: Standard Constructed rules. Draft and Pantheon use different limits.

📘 RULINGS 101 · #1: Main Deck e Material Deck

Nuova rubrica per chi inizia: ogni giovedì una regola di Grand Archive spiegata semplice 🧠

Si parte dalle basi: in GA giochi con DUE mazzi.

🃏 Main Deck: almeno 60 carte, massimo 4 copie per nome. È il mazzo da cui peschi, coperto e mescolato.
✨ Material Deck: massimo 12 carte, tutte diverse, con almeno un champion di livello 0. Qui partono champion e regalia, e puoi guardarlo quando vuoi.

A inizio partita il tuo champion Lv 0 va in campo. Dal secondo turno, nella Materialize Phase, puoi materializzare una carta dal material deck, per esempio il champion di livello successivo per salire di livello.

📌 Regole dello Standard Constructed: Draft e Pantheon hanno limiti diversi.
